flows.title: Share a call recording
steps: Open the call's recording and click the Share button below the meeting title.

To the left of the Copy Link button, choose who can view: Anyone with the link, Anyone on the same domain as you, or Only people added. Anyone with the link leaves the recording open to whoever has the URL; Only people added is the safer choice.
Then either copy the link and share it directly, or enter the email address of the person to share it with. They can view the recording, the transcript and the questions.
For a scheduled call whose attendees were invited, Send Recording shares the attendee link and the questions they asked instead.

flows.title: Copy a call's transcript
steps: Open any recorded call. A transcript cannot be downloaded directly, only copied.
Click the Copy Transcript button directly above the transcript. Fathom copies it to your clipboard.
Go to the app where it belongs and paste it. The transcript is not anywhere until it is pasted.
